# Benefit Builder LLC, full overview

## Company

Benefit Builder LLC is a Texas-based, family-run Section 125 cafeteria plan administrator founded in 2019. We serve employers and brokers across the United States with bundled, all-inclusive monthly pricing. Headquartered at 14132 FM 1097 Rd West, Suite #300, PMB #164, Willis, TX 77318. Reach us at admin@benefitbuilderllc.com or (972) 741-5663. Founder: Bill Dawson.

## What we do

We administer Section 125 cafeteria plans (Premium Only Plans / POP) for employers. The plan lets employees pay for qualifying benefits with pre-tax dollars, which reduces the employer's FICA payroll tax liability up to 7.65% of participating wages and raises employee take-home pay.

Our work covers the full administrative lifecycle:

- Pre-implementation FICA savings analysis. We model the employer's expected payroll tax savings and per-employee take-home pay impact before signing.
- Plan documents. We prepare and maintain the Section 125 plan document, adoption agreement, and salary reduction agreement so the plan is IRS-compliant.
- Non-discrimination testing (NDT). We run annual NDT to confirm the plan does not discriminate in favor of key employees or highly compensated employees.
- Payroll integration. We sync rosters and configure payroll deduction codes with common payroll providers.
- Compliance support. We maintain audit-ready records, handle plan amendments, and provide ongoing compliance check-ins.
- HSA and FSA administration. We administer Health Savings Accounts, Flexible Spending Accounts, and Dependent Care FSAs alongside the core Section 125 plan.
- Supplemental benefits enrollment. We help employers offer life, accident, critical illness, disability, and gap protection with plain-language enrollment communications.
- Broker partnership. We co-broker and accept broker referrals with clear commission economics and bundled compliance support.

## Why employers choose us

- All-inclusive monthly fee. No per-task charges. Compliance, NDT, plan documents, and payroll integration are included.
- Texas-based, family-run. You talk to people, not call queues.
- Bundled compliance. The plan document, adoption agreement, salary reduction agreement, annual NDT, and audit-ready records are all included.
- Plain-language employee communications. Higher participation through better understanding.
- Fast quotes. Most employers get a quote within one business day.

## Why brokers partner with us

- Co-broker or refer. Both models supported.
- Compliance handled. NDT, plan documents, and audit records are our problem, not yours.
- Clear commission economics. No surprise splits.
- Texas brokers welcome. National reach.

## Blog and guides

Plain-language education on Section 125 for employers and the insurance agents who serve them. Standard public facts only.

- Section 125 Cafeteria Plan Basics: what a Section 125 plan is, how pre-tax elections work, why employers use them. /blog/section-125-cafeteria-plan-basics
- How Pre-Tax Benefits Lower Employer FICA Payroll Tax: FICA is 7.65% (Social Security 6.2% to the wage base, Medicare 1.45%); a pre-tax election removes wages from the FICA base, so both employer and employee stop paying 7.65% on those dollars. /blog/how-fica-savings-work-for-employers
- Which Benefits Qualify for Section 125: insurance premiums, health and dependent care FSAs, HSA contributions, and dependent care assistance qualify; long-term care insurance generally does not. /blog/which-benefits-qualify-for-section-125
- Premium Only Plans (POP) Explained: the simplest Section 125 plan, covering only the employee share of insurance premiums; common first plan for small employers. /blog/premium-only-plan-pop-explained
- Section 125 Compliance Checklist for Brokers: plan document, adoption agreement, salary reduction agreements, and annual nondiscrimination testing. /blog/section-125-compliance-checklist-for-brokers
- Nondiscrimination Testing Explained: the three core NDT families (eligibility, contributions and benefits, key-employee concentration). /blog/nondiscrimination-testing-explained-for-agents
- How Agents Grow Their Book with Section 125: pre-tax treatment makes worksite products easier to place; agents keep commissions while Benefit Builder runs the admin. /blog/how-agents-grow-their-book-with-section-125

## Service areas and state tax treatment

Benefit Builder administers Section 125 plans across nine states. Section 125 savings come from FICA (7.65%), federal income tax, and the state's income tax, so the savings differ by state.

- Missouri: flat 4.7% state income tax (standard deduction $16,100). Cities served include Cape Girardeau, Poplar Bluff, and Festus. /locations/missouri
- Texas: no state income tax, so savings come from federal income tax and the 7.65% FICA. Benefit Builder's home state, based in the Conroe and Willis area. Cities served include Conroe, Houston, Baytown, and Laredo. /locations/texas
- Oklahoma: graduated state income tax topping out at 4.75% (standard deduction $6,520). Durant. /locations/oklahoma
- New Mexico: graduated state income tax from 1.7% to 5.9% (standard deduction $16,100). Farmington and the Four Corners. /locations/new-mexico
- Ohio: flat 3.5% state income tax (no standard deduction). Dayton. /locations/ohio
- Michigan: flat 4.05% state income tax (no standard deduction). Southfield and the Detroit metro. /locations/michigan
- Colorado: flat 4.4% state income tax (no standard deduction). Centennial and the Denver metro. /locations/colorado
- Illinois: flat 4.95% state income tax (no standard deduction). /locations/illinois
- Georgia: flat 5.39% state income tax (standard deduction $16,100). /locations/georgia
